SELECT MAX(amount) FROM line WHERE status=1 AND cost_center=3

WITH g AS (SELECT UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(0,7)) AS cost_center) SELECT g.cost_center, COUNT(l.rid) FROM g LEFT JOIN line l ON l.cost_center=g.cost_center AND l.status=1 GROUP BY g.cost_center ORDER BY g.cost_center

WITH g AS (SELECT UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(0,7)) AS cost_center) SELECT g.cost_center, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount),0) FROM g LEFT JOIN line l ON l.cost_center=g.cost_center AND l.status=1 GROUP BY g.cost_center ORDER BY g.cost_center
SELECT SUM(l.amount) FROM line l JOIN partner p ON p.rid=l.partner_id WHERE l.status=1 AND p.country=3
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doc d WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM line l WHERE l.doc_id=d.rid AND l.status=1)
SELECT p.country, SUM(l.amount) FROM line l JOIN partner p ON p.rid=l.partner_id WHERE l.status=1 GROUP BY p.country ORDER BY p.country
